title: Batch-1 refusals with real Claude: flight, table, pay and order asks get the fixed jobs-off line; email and WhatsApp asks are honest, with no invented messages and no Connect card
spec: QA audit 28 Oct: batch-1 items not yet proven with real Claude

steps.expect: Find your AI card; the Anthropic key row offers to add the key
rows tested; the key row waits for a key

steps.note: Add key on the Anthropic key row: opens the Secret box

steps.expect: Secret box asks for the Anthropic key

steps.note: the key typed into foo's own Secret box, masked

steps.expect: the Anthropic key row shows works

only the key works: Use it

steps.expect: step 2 of 2: name card; the finder collapsed to Using Anthropic key

steps.note: foo uses the key, not the Claude app

steps.expect: warm hello with three things to try; composer unlocked

steps.text: Book me a flight to Goa on Sat 12 Dec

steps.expect: a flight booking with jobs off gets the app's fixed line, no plan card, never 'booked'
steps.expectJs: (()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="thread-log"] [data-testid="bubble-foo"]')].at(-1);if(!b)return false;const t=b.innerText;return /can.t do tasks for you yet/i.test(t)&&!/booked|confirmed|PNR/i.test(t)&&!/<\/?say>/.test(t)})()

steps.expect: no apps are connected in batch 1: says plainly it can't read email, invents no inbox, shows no Connect card, never promises to 'look'
steps.expectJs: (()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="thread-log"] [data-testid="bubble-foo"]')].at(-1);if(!b)return false;const t=b.innerText;return /can.?t|cannot|not (yet )?(connected|linked|able)|no access|don.t have access|isn.t connected/i.test(t)&&!/new emails? from|your inbox (has|shows)/i.test(t)&&!/I.ll look/i.test(t)&&!/<\/?say>/.test(t)})()
